_comment: DRAFT (Story 10.7): the demo's ending, the King's messenger (sprint-change-proposal-2026-10-31.md K-2, K-3). When it comes is game_config.json's demo_ending (profiles.demo: on, reputation 32, 2 taxes; the full game never runs it). This file is what the hall shows (scripts/game/royal_messenger.gd). messenger.body: the townsfolk variant id his body comes from (data/characters/townsfolk.json; a placeholder: the guard, until Story 26.3's royal emissary replaces it here). speaker: his id in data/dialogue/speakers.json. dialogue / title: his conversation (its last line's bridge.choose("heard") ends the demo). porch [x, y, z]: where he appears, outside the front door (the staff's porch point); route_in: the points he walks to first, in order (inside the door); then he walks to the player and stops approach_stop_m short (inside his 1.2 m talk zone's reach of the player's 0.5 m capsule, so E works without a step; approach false: he waits at the wait spot instead), re-aiming at most every repath_seconds when the player has moved, and gives up after approach_timeout_seconds for the wait spot; walk_in_timeout_seconds: not inside by then, he is placed at the last route point. wait_spot [x, z, yaw_deg]: where he waits (measured: on the navmesh, 2.3 m from every E zone and the visitors' spots, 4.55 m from every patron seat; Test 53). arrival_delay_seconds: how long into the day phase he comes. text: the banners (arrival; return: a later morning, he was not heard yet) and the E prompt. panel_id: Story 10.1's court panel played before the end card ("" = none; a no-op while no panel director exists). end_card: the 'to be continued' card (kickstarter_line "" = hidden; the button shows after min_seconds; fade_seconds: the fade to black). Every line is DRAFT: Raphael rewrites.

text.banner_arrival: A messenger of the King has come. He's asking for the guild master.
text.banner_return: The King's messenger is back. He still has word for the guild master.
text.prompt: Press E - Hear the King's messenger

end_card.title: To be continued
lines: The King has sent for your guild.
The road from here runs past the border, and further than this tavern.
Thank you for playing the Eternal Guild demo.
